# Student Loan Default - Consequences &amp; Solutions [2026]
> Last updated: 2026-10-28

> Student loan default and defaulted student loans: what happens when you default on student loans, default loan payment consequences

## About
studentloandefault.org is part of the Open Bankruptcy Project (openbankruptcyproject.org), a 501(c)(3) nonprofit building free, open-source tools for bankruptcy court transparency.
